attrs.body:
in0 = load scaled_dot_product_attention_scale[0]
for a0 in 0..32:
    for a1 in 0..256:
        for a2 in 0..128:
            in1 = load q[0, a0, 0, a2]
            in2 = load k[0, a0, a1, a2]
            f32 v0 = multiply(in1, in2)
            acc1 <- add(acc1, v0) over a2
        v1 = multiply(acc1, in0)
        acc0 <- maximum(acc0, v1) over a1
    for a1 in 0..256:
        for a4 in 0..128:
            in3 = load q[0, a0, 0, a4]
            in4 = load k[0, a0, a1, a4]
            f32 v2 = multiply(in3, in4)
            acc3 <- add(acc3, v2) over a4
        v3 = multiply(acc3, in0)
        v4 = subtract(v3, acc0)
        v5 = exp(v4)
        acc2 <- add(acc2, v5) over a1
    for a5 in 0..128:
        for a6 in 0..256:
            for a7 in 0..128:
                in5 = load q[0, a0, 0, a7]
                in6 = load k[0, a0, a6, a7]
                f32 v6 = multiply(in5, in6)
                acc5 <- add(acc5, v6) over a7
            v7 = multiply(acc5, in0)
            v8 = subtract(v7, acc0)
            v9 = exp(v8)
            v10 = divide(v9, acc2)
            in7 = load v[0, a0, a6, a5]
            v11 = multiply(in7, v10)
            acc4 <- add(acc4, v11) over a6
        scaled_dot_product_attention[0, a0, 0, a5] = acc4
